اصطفقا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَفَقَا (iṣṭafaqā) /isˤ.tˤa.fa.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# اِصْطَفِقَا (iṣṭafiqā) /isˤ.tˤa.fi.qaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
